Call ensure_key_salt before creating KeyManager. If salt setup fails, startup must stop rather than initialize the manager.
The topN value used to allocate buf must not exceed maxSimpleTopN, so the resulting slice stays at or below 1 MiB.

explanation: When meta.abi_version is absent, this conversion must produce None. Treating an absent version as the current ABI would be unsafe. #1784 is the related issue.
TLP reads /etc/tlp.conf after drop-in files, so its settings override values written to /etc/tlp.d/90-power.conf by write_dropin.

The set_key setting assumes TLP version 1.10 or newer; _AC, _BAT and _SAV name profile variants. Leave the _AC variant unset so GNOME’s Performance toggle continues to work. This call sets only the battery variant.
The JsonException handler returns null so the caller can log a parse warning; throwing the parse error would bypass that intended handling.
When AllowedTools is set, RemoveSkipPermissions must remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from args. That flag would bypass the --allowedTools restriction.
Consult is_definitely_dead_code in rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs for the verdict table used to interpret whether this thunk is dead.

explanation: repos_skipped is currently fixed at zero. A future change should derive it from the domains-to-repositories mapping. #874 tracks that work.
index.regex_query is expected to use a linear-time DFA, with no regex backtracking. This explains the performance expectation for the call.
Keep the token-family table schema in this SQL definition aligned with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py; both define or depend on the same schema.
MAX_BATCH is 500 because the vendor batch API accepts at most 500 items. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor API documentation.
Keep these Status values aligned with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Reordering the iota constants changes the meaning of status integers already stored. #88 is the related issue.
The index must list tenant_id before created_at, matching the column order expected by the orders_by_tenant query.
TList.Add must preserve FCount at or below the length of FItems. Grow is the operation that maintains capacity when needed.
close must flush buffered data before closing the sink, because closing drops _buf and could lose its contents.
userPath comes from a request. Resolve it relative to workspaceRoot and reject paths whose '..' components escape that root; normalization alone does not show the required rejection.
Drain the ring before freeing buf. If buf is freed first, the interrupt handler could still use it and cause a use-after-free. #2201 is the related issue.

Reserve capacity for n items before appending so the vector can allocate once. Growth during push_back accounted for 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
Use HOLDLOCK on this SQL Server MERGE to prevent concurrent upserts from racing. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency section of the MERGE documentation.
Use an autonomous transaction for the audit operation so its row survives even if the caller rolls back its own transaction.
This migration creates a replacement table because SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the relevant constraints directly. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to documentation for other ALTER TABLE changes.
Poll every five seconds instead of relying on inotify, because NFS mounts do not emit the inotify events this scan would need.
Keep the awaited jobs in a for...of loop. Using await inside forEach would let errors escape the intended try/catch.
A decoded Vec<u8> frame must be no longer than MAX_FRAME; read_frame is expected to reject larger frames.
Register drainHook before starting the pool so a SIGTERM can trigger a hook that drains it.
Move the fixed retry policy in backoff into configuration. The task is done when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of transitions among the LeaseState values Active, Released and Stale.
Pass the token to tool login through stdin, never a command-line argument, because other users can see argv through ps.
Create app_reader before granting it table access. Migration 042 assumes that role already exists.
Make on_event idempotent because Stripe can retry the same webhook for three days. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the webhook-retries section of the Stripe documentation.
Compare the supplied and expected MACs with hmac.Equal, which runs in constant time. Using == could expose information through timing.
Build the graph once per index at O(edges) cost. Rebuilding it for each query would repeat that work.
The packed TCustomerRec layout is part of the saved .dat file format. Changing it can break existing files, so bump FILE_VERSION when the layout changes.
Keep MSG_MAX in this file synchronized with MSG_MAX_WIRE in proto/messages.h; change both constants together.
After authMiddleware has run, handler may rely on session.userId being non-null.
Synchronize access to cache because its check-then-put sequence must be atomic; the comment says a ConcurrentHashMap alone would not provide that sequence-level guarantee.
The repository alias comes from a user. Validate it against the registry before using it in a path join, to prevent an untrusted alias from selecting an unintended path. #1996 is the related issue.
Payment Amount must be nonnegative. Represent refunds as separate rows whose Kind is 'R', rather than as negative amounts.
Set the worker’s stop flag before joining its thread. Otherwise join can wait forever for a worker that was never told to stop.
The limiter is based on GitHub’s stated allowance of 5,000 API requests per hour per token. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the REST API rate-limits documentation.
unsure: The comment does not explain the chosen 720 ms interval or burst size beyond their connection to the stated hourly limit.

Do not share _lease between jobs: doing so could expose one user’s credentials to another job. #77 is the related issue.

Sweep must evict a bucket only when it has been idle long enough and would be full at now. Evicting on idle time alone would recreate the key with a full balance before its refill time. TestSweepKeepsBucketsThatWouldNotBeFullYet is the regression test.
Use 1-eps as the admission threshold because repeated fractional refills can leave a token balance slightly below 1. TestFractionalRefillIsPreservedAcrossRequests checks this behavior.
The double cast treats insert.get’s result as TransferRow because the INSERT RETURNING operation is expected to yield exactly one row, making a null check unnecessary.

explanation: After enabling foreign keys, query sqlite_schema to force SQLite to read the database schema. The comment says PRAGMAs alone do not read the file, so this query detects a file that is not a database.

Keep the guarded call to sys.set_int_max_str_digits(0). On CPython 3.9.14 and later, removing it can cause a ValueError when handling integers beyond the 4,300-digit limit. The hasattr guard handles runtimes without that function.
Keep the 'equity' account-name literal in this trigger synchronized with EQUITY_ACCOUNT in src/ledger.ts. The trigger uses that literal to distinguish equity entries.
Recheck whether each migration was applied after acquiring the write lock. Another migrator could apply it after the initial pending scan; trusting that scan would apply it twice.
Keep sys.set_int_max_str_digits(0) before printing fib(n). Without it, converting an integer longer than 4,300 digits to a string raises ValueError.
For attempts greater than zero, backoff must return a delay no greater than maxBackoff. The first try should have no wait.
